what_this_is: The 200 trajectories of the study regenerated with a second agent backbone, everything else held fixed and taken from the released artefact. No labels: this corpus tests how the signals behave on another backbone, not whether the taxonomy transfers.
deliberate_difference: each model is prompted through its own chat template, since presenting this model with a prompt written for Qwen would handicap it for an unrelated reason
also_a_judge_in_the_paper: this model is used as a second judge on the original corpus; the corpus produced here is new and the judge comparison is scored on the original one, so the roles do not overlap
